Callout.Name: Theft from a Building Site
Callout.Message: Plant and tools taken from a building site overnight.

Script.Line: The fence was cut when we got here at six.
The digger needs a low-loader and a key, and we keep both on site.
Nobody heard anything and the dogs did not wake up.

Lines.Approach: The fence is cut and the digger is gone. That took a low-loader and nobody saw a low-loader.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
